# WitMotion Windows PC software (official)

Downloaded from WitMotion’s [Download Center](https://wit-motion.com/searchq.html)
→ Google Drive folder
[Software for Windows PC](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1TLutidDBd_tDg5aTXgjvkz63OVt5_8ZZ).

| File | Source | Contents |
|------|--------|----------|
| `WitMotion-Software.zip` | Drive id `10xysnkuyUwi3AK_t3965SLr5Yt6YKE-u` | Current **WitMotion.exe** (V2025.11.26.0) |
| `Standard-Software-for-Windows-PC.zip` | Drive id `15e6y8kpbB8V30VAN0tIwMZzcb78jeJ-j` | Older Minimu / 3D demo pack |
| `CH340-CP2102-Driver.zip` | Drive id `1JidopB42R9EsCzMAYC3Ya9eJ8JbHapRF` | USB-UART drivers for Windows |

On Windows: unzip `WitMotion-Software.zip` and run `Witmotion(V2025.11.26.0) (1)/WitMotion.exe`
(or the copy under `Bin/`). Install the CH340 driver if the COM port is missing.

On Linux, use `tools/witmotion_cube.py` (Calibrate… button) for the same CALSW UART sequence.
